headline: Nitori Furniture Data Breach Potentially Exposes 37.6M Records
tldr: Japanese retailer Nitori discovered an unauthorized network access that may have compromised up to 37.62 million customer records.
action: Monitor accounts for suspicious activity if you are a Nitori customer.

headline: WWBN AVideo Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2026-126542)
tldr: WWBN AVideo versions 6.5 through 29.7.1 contain an authentication bypass via Hybridauth social login display names, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user including administrators.
action: Upgrade WWBN AVideo to a patched version.

headline: React Server Components Unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-126187)
tldr: Certain React Server Components packages contain an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability affecting specific versions when processing crafted payloads with multiple typed arrays.
action: Update react-server-dom-webpack, react-server-dom-parcel, and react-server-dom-turbopack to patched versions immediately.

headline: Railway Cloud Breach Exposes AI API Keys and Causes $740K Fraud
tldr: Cloud hosting provider Railway suffered a breach where hackers stole customer authentication secrets and API keys, generating $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage and potentially exposing up to 100,000 workspaces.
action: Rotate all API keys and secrets previously stored on Railway.

headline: Adobe Connect Incorrect Authorization Flaw (CVE-2026-121355)
tldr: Adobe Connect contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain elevated access to sensitive information or functionality without user interaction.
action: Apply the latest updates for Adobe Connect.

headline: Intel and AMD Patch Over 200 Vulnerabilities
tldr: Intel and AMD released their Patch Tuesday advisories addressing more than 200 vulnerabilities, including critical Intel TDX software flaws and AMD graphics bugs.
action: Apply the latest CPU microcode and vendor firmware updates.

headline: Adobe Connect Stored XSS Vulnerability (CVE-2026-121904)
tldr: Adobe Connect is affected by a stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability allowing a low-privileged user to inject malicious scripts into form fields and potentially compromise victim sessions.
action: Apply the latest security updates from Adobe.

headline: Grok Build Coding Agent Leaks Confidential Info
tldr: A security researcher found 35,000 Grok Build applications exposed without authentication, leaking confidential information including data belonging to SpaceX.
action: Audit Grok Build applications and ensure proper authentication controls are enforced.

headline: Microsoft Office Outlook Zero-Day (CVE-2026-124194) Actively Exploited
tldr: Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes an actively exploited Outlook zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-124194) involving a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action.
action: Apply the November 2026 Microsoft security updates immediately.

headline: AhsayCBS Flaws (CVE-2026-105133, CVE-2026-105134) Exploited to Deploy Backdoor
tldr: Attackers exploited vulnerabilities CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134 in AhsayCBS to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary commands, deploying a sandbox-evading Python backdoor.
action: Apply available patches for AhsayCBS and audit systems for unauthorized Python backdoors.

headline: Xen Orchestra Auth Bypass (VSA-2026-062) Actively Exploited
tldr: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Xen Orchestra (VSA-2026-062) is actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to gain administrator privileges and take over XCP-ng virtualization hosts.
action: Apply updates provided by Vates VMS immediately and check logs for signs of compromise.

headline: Cisco BroadWorks XXE Vulnerability (CVE-2026-20320) Added to KEV
tldr: Cisco BroadWorks contains an XML external entity reference vulnerability (CVE-2026-20320) allowing remote unauthenticated attackers to read sensitive configuration information.
action: Apply vendor mitigations in accordance with CISA BOD 26-04 guidance.

headline: iOS Sandbox Escape Flaw Threatens Crypto Wallets on iOS 26 and 27
tldr: An active iOS sandbox escape published on GitHub affects iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1, and 27.2, allowing third-party apps to read private files and expose cryptocurrency seed phrases and keys.
action: Exercise caution when installing third-party iOS applications; monitor for an official Apple patch.

headline: Openwave Messaging Webtop Media Transcoder Flaw in KEV
tldr: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability (CVE-2026-111793) added to CISA KEV.
action: Apply vendor mitigations in accordance with CISA BOD 26-04.

headline: Russian Hackers Compromise Government Email Servers in Romania and Kazakhstan
tldr: State-linked hackers compromised government email servers in Romania and Kazakhstan to intercept correspondence with NATO and EU officials.
action: Audit government and diplomatic mail infrastructure for unauthorized access and review external mail relay logs.

headline: SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI Inference Servers
tldr: An attacker exploited an RCE flaw in the SGLang inference engine to run code on a NEAR AI inference server and access processing requests.
action: Upgrade SGLang and review inference server access logs for unauthorized execution.

headline: npm:mongoose sanitizeFilter Bypassed in countDocuments (CVE-2026-125120)
tldr: Mongoose versions prior to patches fail to apply sanitizeFilter on countDocuments queries, risking query selector injection attacks.
action: Upgrade Mongoose to version 9.9.2+, 8.24.3+, 7.8.12+, or 6.13.11+.

headline: npm:bitcoinjs-lib Merkle Node Duplication Vulnerability (CVE-2026-107846)
tldr: bitcoinjs-lib contains an undetected merkle node duplication flaw in block root computation that can validate forged transaction lists with valid proof of work.
action: Review advisory details and update bitcoinjs-lib packages.

headline: npm:node-opcua Namespace-Level RBAC Fail-Open Flaw (CVE-2026-95860)
tldr: An unauthenticated client can write protected variables and call privileged methods on OPC UA nodes lacking explicit per-node permissions due to a fail-open default in node-opcua.
action: Upgrade node-opcua packages and verify explicit permissions on namespace nodes.

headline: Adobe Patches 110 Vulnerabilities Across 9 Products
tldr: Adobe fixed 110 vulnerabilities across products including AEM, Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects, and Connect.
action: Apply the latest updates for Adobe products across the enterprise.

headline: Git RCE Vulnerability in Recursive Clones (CVE-2026-111760)
tldr: An integer truncation flaw in Git allows malicious repositories to execute code during recursive clones and submodule handling. Fixed in Git versions 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1.

headline: China-Nexus Sparrow Malware Ecosystem Targets Telecom and Government
tldr: Three threat clusters (including SilentDelivery) linked through shared infrastructure and the Sparrow malware have targeted telecom, government, and critical infrastructure across Latin America, Asia, and Europe.
action: Monitor networks for indicators associated with the Sparrow malware ecosystem and Chinese espionage campaigns.

headline: Now exploited: Google Chrome XML Use-After-Free Vulnerability (CVE-2026-125350)
tldr: Google has issued an emergency security update to patch a high-severity use-after-free vulnerability in Chrome's XML component (CVE-2026-125350), which is actively exploited in the wild as a zero-day.
action: Update Google Chrome to the latest version immediately.

headline: Now exploited: Barracuda ESG Flaws Exploited to Gain Root Access
tldr: Barracuda Networks warned that attackers are actively exploiting recently patched Email Security Gateway (ESG) vulnerabilities to achieve root command execution.
action: Ensure all Barracuda Email Security Gateway appliances are fully patched and inspect for signs of compromise.

headline: Turla Threat Group Deploys Cereal Malware Against Exchange Servers
tldr: The Russian state-sponsored threat group Turla is using a newly discovered modular malware toolset called 'Cereal' to target Microsoft Exchange servers at government organizations and intercept emails.
action: Audit Microsoft Exchange servers for unauthorized access and monitor for indicators of compromise related to Cereal malware.

headline: France Blames Iran for Sabotage Attack on Supermarket Refrigerators
tldr: The French government stated that an October cyberattack affecting refrigeration controllers at roughly 700 retail sites, causing food losses and fires, was conducted by Iran's IRGC.
action: Isolate and secure industrial refrigeration and HVAC controllers from direct internet access.

headline: SAP November 2026 Patches Fixes Multiple Maximum-Severity Flaws
tldr: SAP released its November 2026 security updates patching 35 vulnerabilities, including four maximum-severity issues affecting NetWeaver, Web Dispatcher, and Gateway software.
action: Apply SAP November 2026 security updates across all affected NetWeaver and Web Dispatcher instances.

headline: Apple Patches iMessage Privacy Flaws and Bluetooth Issues
tldr: Apple released security updates to fix iMessage privacy vulnerabilities allowing unauthorized users to join group chats and view past messages, alongside Bluetooth pairing flaws.
action: Update Apple devices to the latest available software versions.

headline: Fireworks AI Discloses Breach Following Third-Party Cloud Compromise
tldr: AI startup Fireworks AI disclosed a security breach where attackers accessed development machines after compromising a third-party cloud provider.
action: Review third-party cloud access controls and audit development machine logs.

headline: N-able Takes Cloud Platform Offline Following Zero-Day Disclosures
tldr: N-able took hosted N-central environments offline and advised on-premises customers to shut down servers after a researcher published over 30 alleged zero-days.
action: Take N-central servers offline per vendor advisory until patches are available.

headline: SAP NetWeaver Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
tldr: SAP NetWeaver lacks sufficient input validation and authorization checks in remote-enabled functionality, allowing low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code.
action: Apply relevant SAP security patches for NetWeaver.

headline: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
tldr: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP and ABAP Platform inadequately verify incoming authentication assertions under specific configurations, enabling user impersonation.
action: Apply SAP security updates for AS ABAP.

headline: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP Memory Corruption Flaw
tldr: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP insufficiently validates network input, allowing unauthenticated attackers to trigger memory corruption and execute code.
action: Apply SAP security patches.

headline: SAP Gateway Default Access Control List Misconfiguration
tldr: SAP Gateway activates a default Access Control List with high privileges, allowing external attackers to be treated as internal application servers.
action: Review and harden SAP Gateway ACL configurations.

headline: SAP Web Dispatcher Memory Corruption Vulnerability
tldr: SAP Web Dispatcher improperly validates network input, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to trigger memory corruption and achieve full system compromise.
action: Apply SAP security patches.

headline: Kubero Authentication Bypass via Hardcoded JWT Secret
tldr: Kubero versions 3.0.0 through 3.1.1 use a hardcoded fallback signing secret when JWT_SECRET is unset, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge administrative JWTs.
action: Set a secure, unique JWT_SECRET environment variable and upgrade Kubero.

headline: INDOTALENT WHMS Authentication Bypass via Hard-coded JWT Key
tldr: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 contains a hard-coded JWT signing key and issuer in appsettings.json, allowing attackers to forge administrator tokens.
action: Upgrade INDOTALENT WHMS to version 10.20261109 or later.

headline: SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management XSL Transformation Flaw
tldr: SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management (XML Forms) permits unauthorized XSL transformations leading to potential code execution.
action: Apply relevant SAP security patches.

headline: D-Link M60 MQTT Broker Hard-coded Credentials Flaw
tldr: D-Link M60 version 1.12.B01 contains hard-coded credentials within the emDaemon MQTT Broker configuration.
action: Apply firmware updates from D-Link or restrict remote access to the device.

headline: SAP NetWeaver ABAP Platform Missing Authorization Check
tldr: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP lacks authorization checks for internal functionality, enabling low-privileged users to execute OS commands.
action: Apply SAP security patches.

headline: SAP Web Dispatcher and ICM Request Validation Flaw
tldr: SAP Web Dispatcher and ICM lack sufficient request validation, exposing administrative functionality to cross-site request attacks.
action: Apply SAP security notes.

headline: Kubeflow Pipelines API Server Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
tldr: In multi-user mode, Kubeflow Pipelines API server upload endpoints fail to perform authorization when the target namespace is empty, allowing shared pipeline uploads.
action: Review Kubeflow Pipelines configurations and restrict access to multi-user upload endpoints.

headline: York University Cyberattack Exposes Personal Data
tldr: York University suffered a cybersecurity incident involving the theft of personal information submitted through online forms dating back to 2007.
action: Monitor accounts and review data retention practices for online form submissions.

headline: INDOTALENT WHMS Default Credentials Vulnerability
tldr: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 creates a default admin account with hardcoded credentials (admin@root.com / 123456).
action: Change or remove default administrative credentials immediately.

headline: SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence External Entity Vulnerability
tldr: SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform (Web Intelligence) fails to properly restrict external entity resolution during OLAP connection requests, allowing file reading.
action: Apply SAP security notes for BusinessObjects.

headline: Pocket ID Email Verification Token Reuse Vulnerability
tldr: Pocket ID allows email verification tokens to remain valid after an account email address change, enabling verified-email spoofing.
action: Upgrade Pocket ID backend to a patched version when available.

headline: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability (CVE-2026-102895)
tldr: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability allowing unauthenticated administrative access, API-key creation, secret disclosure, and code execution. The vulnerability is actively exploited and listed in CISA KEV.
action: Apply vendor mitigations immediately per CISA KEV and BOD 26-04 guidelines.

headline: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability (CVE-2026-116779)
tldr: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability enabling configuration/credential disclosure, call control, and command execution. The flaw is actively exploited and listed in CISA KEV.
action: Apply vendor mitigations immediately or discontinue use of the product per CISA KEV guidelines.

headline: Qubole AWS Access Compromised to Breach Customer Accounts
tldr: Attackers used Qubole trusted AWS access credentials between October 14 and October 26 to breach multiple customer accounts and steal stored secrets and data.
action: Audit AWS accounts connected to Qubole for unauthorized access and rotate exposed credentials.

headline: Russian Cloud Provider Beget Rebuilds After Wiper Attack
tldr: Russian cloud services provider Beget was forced to rebuild its cloud infrastructure from scratch following a data-wiping malware attack.

headline: Plex2Shell Exploit Chain Targeted Against QNAP NAS Users
tldr: Threat actors are actively exploiting a four-flaw exploit chain targeting the Plex Media Server application on QNAP NAS devices.
action: Audit QNAP NAS devices and update Plex Media Server applications.

headline: Ethersphere bee-js and Swarm Desktop Compromised for Malware
tldr: Attackers compromised release automation to publish malicious versions bee-js 13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop 0.56.2, which steal wallet keys and install backdoors.
action: Downgrade or remove affected versions of bee-js and Swarm Desktop and check for compromised crypto wallets.

headline: Web3Auth Flaw Exploited to Steal Keplr Crypto Wallets
tldr: Attackers exploited a security flaw in Web3Auth used by Keplr for Google and Apple sign-in to steal funds from crypto wallets.
action: Review Web3Auth integrations and monitor crypto wallet security.

headline: LNbits Urges Server Shutdown Amid Active Exploitation Attacks
tldr: The LNbits Bitcoin Lightning wallet project urged operators to shut down servers immediately due to a wave of attacks exploiting new accounts to drain funds.
action: Shut down LNbits servers immediately until security fixes are released and applied.

headline: rConfig Core and Pro Deserialization RCE Vulnerability (CVE-2026-124079)
tldr: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.19 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.1 contain a deserialization vulnerability allowing unauthenticated network attackers to execute arbitrary code via Redis-backed Laravel Horizon queues.
action: Upgrade rConfig Core to 8.2.19+ and rConfig Pro to 8.4.1+.

headline: Automaker Apps Vulnerable via Default ForgeRock Credentials
tldr: Researchers found default admin credentials on ForgeRock identity servers used by two car brands, allowing complete account takeover, remote door unlocking, and engine starting.
action: Change default credentials on identity provider servers and enforce strict authentication policies.

headline: German Web Host Breached via AI Assistant Integration Interface
tldr: A German web hosting company was breached after attackers exploited an interface designed to connect customer accounts with AI assistants.

headline: Frontline Education Data Breach Affects Over 3 Million
tldr: Frontline Education reported that an August data breach impacted over 3 million school district staff and students.

headline: Tasmota Heap Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability (CVE-2026-119756)
tldr: Tasmota through 16.0.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in SendReceiveDeviceGroupMessage() allowing local network attackers to corrupt memory via UDP port 4447.
action: Apply patch from commit e97e1e4 or update Tasmota.

headline: fastapi-code-generator Import-Time RCE via Route Path (CVE-2026-63471)
tldr: fastapi-code-generator 0.8.0 emits unescaped route paths into decorators, allowing import-time remote code execution when generated code is loaded by an ASGI server.
action: Update fastapi-code-generator and audit generated application code.

headline: fastapi-code-generator Import-Time RCE via Status Code (CVE-2026-63469)
tldr: fastapi-code-generator 0.8.0 emits unescaped response status-code keys into decorator response dictionaries, allowing import-time code execution when generated code is loaded.
action: Update fastapi-code-generator and audit generated application code.

headline: fastapi-code-generator Call-Time RCE via Summary (CVE-2026-63470)
tldr: fastapi-code-generator 0.8.0 emits unescaped operation summaries into docstrings, allowing code execution when the generated route handler endpoint is called.
action: Update fastapi-code-generator and audit generated application code.

headline: Vanderbilt University Announces Cyberattack Impacting Systems
tldr: Vanderbilt University warned students and employees of a cyberattack impacting campus devices and systems.

headline: Revolve Data Breach Impacts 1.5 Million Individuals
tldr: Online fashion retailer Revolve disclosed that a September cyberattack affected more than 1.5 million individuals.

headline: Amplifon Americas Data Breach Impacts 1.3 Million
tldr: Amplifon Americas suffered a data breach where hackers stole personal, health, and insurance information, including Social Security numbers.

headline: U.S. Agencies Warn of Attacks on Industrial Refrigeration Controllers
tldr: Threat actors are actively targeting unpatched or internet-accessible industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems globally, potentially causing service disruptions, fire hazards, and inventory loss. U.S. government agencies issued an alert regarding these attacks.
action: Audit industrial refrigeration controllers, disconnect them from the public internet, and apply available patches.

headline: IBM Concert Unsafe Command Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-15266)
tldr: IBM Concert 1.0 through 3.0.1.1 contains components allowing unsafe command execution, enabling remote attackers to run arbitrary system commands on the host.
action: Apply the latest security updates for IBM Concert versions 1.0 through 3.0.1.1.

headline: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data Path Traversal (CVE-2026-107331)
tldr: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 contains an absolute-path traversal vulnerability allowing remote authenticated attackers to obtain sensitive information.
action: Apply available patches from IBM for DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0.

headline: IBM Process Mining Access Control Vulnerability (CVE-2026-114464)
tldr: IBM Process Mining 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 contains an improper access control flaw allowing remote attackers to obtain sensitive information.
action: Upgrade IBM Process Mining to version 2.2.2 or later.

headline: IBM Optim Path Traversal Vulnerability (CVE-2026-17466)
tldr: IBM Optim 1.0.0, 1.1.0, and 1.2.0 allow remote authenticated attackers to obtain sensitive information via path traversal.
action: Apply fixes provided by IBM for Optim versions 1.0.0, 1.1.0, and 1.2.0.

headline: Kyverno Namespace Clamp Authorization Bypass (CVE-2026-124440)
tldr: Kyverno 1.19.1 contains an authorization bypass allowing namespace tenants to issue cluster-scoped API requests and escalate to cluster admin.
action: Upgrade Kyverno to 1.19.2 or later.

headline: OpenEMR Path Traversal and RCE Vulnerability (CVE-2026-124450)
tldr: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the fax/sms module, allowing low-privilege users to read configuration files and achieve RCE.
action: Upgrade OpenEMR to 8.3.0 or later.

headline: Iris Ohyama Cloud Service Breach Exposes 7.7 Million Records
tldr: Japanese manufacturer Iris Ohyama disclosed that unauthorized access to a third-party cloud service exposed personal information of about 7.7 million people.
action: Audit third-party cloud service integrations and monitor affected customer data.

headline: Craft CMS GraphQL Auth Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2026-124427)
tldr: Craft CMS 5.0.0 through 5.11.1 contains an authorization bypass allowing anonymous GraphQL clients to read out-of-scope section entries.
action: Upgrade Craft CMS to 5.11.2 or later.

headline: OpenEMR OneTimeAuth Token Replay Flaw (CVE-2026-124445)
tldr: OpenEMR 7.0.1 through 8.3.x ignores one-time use flags and lacks rate limiting on PINs, allowing token replay to expose patient data.
action: Upgrade OpenEMR to 8.4.0 or later.

headline: OpenEMR SQL Injection Vulnerability (CVE-2026-124469)
tldr: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an SQL injection flaw in the Fee Sheet drug-inventory lookup, enabling data extraction.
action: Upgrade OpenEMR to 8.3.0 or later.

headline: IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale CSP Bypass (CVE-2026-101117)
tldr: IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale 8.6.1.0 to 8.6.2.2 contains a security restriction bypass due to improper Content Security Policy configuration.
action: Apply fixes provided by IBM for WebSphere Extreme Scale.

headline: OpenAM Self-Registration Privilege Escalation Vulnerability (CVE-2026-123549)
tldr: OpenAM before 16.1.4 fails to enforce the Valid Creation Attributes list during self-registration, allowing anonymous attackers to assign themselves to administrative groups and gain full administrative control.
action: Upgrade OpenAM to version 16.1.4 or later.

headline: OpenAM SAML Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2026-123550)
tldr: OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an authentication bypass in its SAML v2.0 service provider that accepts unsigned assertions, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge sessions for arbitrary users.
action: Upgrade OpenAM to version 16.1.4 or later.

headline: OpenAM WebSocket Session Disclosure Vulnerability (CVE-2026-123551)
tldr: OpenAM versions 14.0.0 through 16.1.3 allow unauthenticated attackers to read live session tokens from the notification WebSocket, enabling session hijacking.
action: Upgrade OpenAM to version 16.1.4 or later.

headline: imgproxy ICO Loader Integer Overflow Vulnerability (CVE-2026-123614)
tldr: imgproxy 4.0.0 through 4.0.15 contains an integer overflow in the ICO loader, allowing remote attackers to trigger a heap buffer overflow via crafted images.
action: Upgrade imgproxy to version 4.0.16 or later.

headline: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Hit by $133 Million Cyberattack via Service Provider
tldr: French cooperative bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa suffered a cyberattack via a service provider resulting in $133 million in fraudulent transactions, prompting system suspensions.

headline: Keycloak Client Management RCE Vulnerability (CVE-2026-120984)
tldr: A vulnerability in Keycloak's client management component allows authenticated attackers with client management permissions to upload and execute malicious JavaScript policies, leading to remote code execution.
action: Apply the latest vendor patches for Keycloak to address CVE-2026-120984.

headline: IBM API Connect Hard-Coded Credentials Flaw (CVE-2026-17360)
tldr: IBM API Connect versions 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 use hard-coded credentials, allowing remote attackers to gain full administrative control.
action: Apply available vendor patches for IBM API Connect 12.1 immediately.

headline: IBM API Connect OS Command Injection Flaw (CVE-2026-17402)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 allow remote command execution via unneutralized OS command input.
action: Apply available vendor patches for IBM API Connect immediately.

headline: IBM API Connect Hard-Coded Credentials Flaw (CVE-2026-17403)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 contain hard-coded credentials allowing full administrative control.
action: Apply available vendor patches for IBM API Connect immediately.

headline: IBM API Connect OS Command Injection Flaw (CVE-2026-17408)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via OS command injection.
action: Apply available vendor patches for IBM API Connect immediately.

headline: Now exploited: IBM Aspera Faspex Authorization Bypass Flaw (CVE-2026-123218)
tldr: IBM Aspera Faspex versions 5.0.0 through 5.0.19 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability allowing an authorized user to craft specific messages and gain full administrative privileges.
action: Upgrade IBM Aspera Faspex to the latest patched version.

headline: IBM API Connect Authentication Bypass Flaw (CVE-2026-16720)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 allow remote attackers to obtain valid access tokens and assume other users' identities due to improper directory service authentication enforcement.
action: Apply available security patches for IBM API Connect.

headline: IBM API Connect Arbitrary Code Execution Flaw (CVE-2026-17117)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 permit remote authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via improperly controlled object attribute modifications.
action: Upgrade IBM API Connect to the latest release.

headline: IBM API Connect SQL Injection Flaw (CVE-2026-17132)
tldr: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 contains an SQL injection vulnerability allowing remote authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands.
action: Update IBM API Connect immediately.

headline: IBM API Connect Path Traversal RCE Flaw (CVE-2026-17147)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 contain a path traversal vulnerability allowing remote code execution and administrative actions.
action: Upgrade IBM API Connect to a patched version.

headline: IBM API Connect Custom Module Code Execution Flaw (CVE-2026-17150)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 lack sufficient validation for uploaded custom modules, allowing cross-tenant code execution.
action: Apply security updates for IBM API Connect.

headline: IBM API Connect Privilege Escalation Flaw (CVE-2026-17158)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 contain an improper authentication issue allowing privilege escalation for authenticated attackers.
action: Update IBM API Connect to the latest release.

headline: IBM API Connect Improper Authentication Flaw (CVE-2026-17278)
tldr: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 contains an improper authentication flaw allowing unauthorized access to API catalog and runtime configurations.
action: Apply vendor patches for IBM API Connect.

headline: IBM API Connect BOLA Flaw (CVE-2026-17292)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 contain incomplete access checks allowing remote authenticated attackers to take over organization ownership.
action: Update IBM API Connect to a secured version.

headline: IBM API Connect Open Redirect Account Takeover (CVE-2026-17297)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 contain an open redirect vulnerability during sign-in that can lead to account takeover.

headline: IBM API Connect Arbitrary File Read and SSRF (CVE-2026-17299)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 permit arbitrary file reads and SSRF due to unrestricted resolution of external references in definitions.

headline: IBM API Connect Cryptographic Signature Bypass (CVE-2026-17301)
tldr: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability due to improper cryptographic signature verification.

tldr: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 allows remote attackers to take control of gateway configuration and obtain sensitive information via an alternate path authentication bypass.
action: Apply patches provided by IBM for API Connect.

headline: IBM API Connect SQL Injection Flaw (CVE-2026-17336)
tldr: IBM API Connect versions 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 allow authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands.
action: Apply available vendor patches for IBM API Connect 12.1.

headline: IBM API Connect Path Traversal Flaw (CVE-2026-17339)
tldr: IBM API Connect versions 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 contain a path traversal vulnerability allowing cross-tenant resource access or deletion.
action: Apply available vendor patches for IBM API Connect 12.1.

headline: IBM API Connect Path Traversal RCE Flaw (CVE-2026-17340)
tldr: IBM API Connect versions 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 are vulnerable to path traversal allowing remote code execution.

tldr: Zyxel GS1900 network switches that received the vendor's earlier fix for an actively exploited flaw are still open to the exploit attackers used, researchers at Binarly found. The exploit lets anyone who can reach a switch's web management interface run commands on it without logging in.

headline: BTCPay Server Hot Wallet Crypto Thefts
tldr: Maintainers of BTCPay Server warned users that hackers have been draining hot wallets on instances running outdated versions.
action: Update BTCPay Server to the latest version immediately.

headline: Synology Warns of C3RB3R Ransomware NAS Attacks
tldr: Synology warned customers to update NAS devices immediately due to a surge in active C3RB3r ransomware attacks.
action: Update Synology NAS devices immediately.

headline: Malicious Claude Code Extension in Cursor Supply Chain
tldr: A malicious Claude Code extension served in a Cursor supply chain attack performed host reconnaissance and attempted a reverse SSH tunnel.
action: Audit Cursor extensions for unauthorized or malicious components.

headline: Teams Impersonation and AD CS Certificate Abuse
tldr: Attackers posing as IT support on Microsoft Teams tricked employees into granting remote access, then abused AD CS settings to steal privileged certificates.
action: Audit Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) configurations and enforce phishing-resistant MFA.

headline: Control Web Panel OS Command Injection Flaw
tldr: Control Web Panel (CWP) before version 1.16 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the protected_directory module allowing arbitrary command execution.
action: Upgrade Control Web Panel to version 1.16 or later.

headline: Ukrainian and Russian Air Raid Apps Hacked
tldr: Emergency air raid alert systems in Ukraine and Russia were hacked to spread fake nuclear attack warnings.

headline: Revolve Data Breach Impacts 180,000 Customers
tldr: Hackers accessed Revolve's online shopping platform and stole personal and payment card information affecting at least 180,000 individuals.

headline: Polymarket Funds Returned Following DNS Hijack
tldr: Polymarket returned funds to traders after DebugBear suffered a DNS hijack via its domain registrar affecting a customer.
action: Audit DNS registrar security and enable registry locks.

headline: DarkBlinders Targets Israel and Iraqi Kurdistan Cloud
tldr: An Iran-aligned threat actor conducted espionage campaigns compromising targets in Israel and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq between August and October 2026.

headline: Government Linux Servers Targeted by SysGoRAT
tldr: Palo Alto Networks discovered a cyber espionage campaign targeting government Linux infrastructure using SysGoRAT and scripts.
action: Monitor Linux environments for unauthorized remote access tools and anomalous scripts.

headline: ape-volo-admin Auth Bypass via Hardcoded JWT Key
tldr: ape-volo-admin before 3.6.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens using a hardcoded JWT signing key.
action: Upgrade ape-volo-admin to version 3.6.1 or later.

headline: madong-admin-saas Missing Authentication Flaw
tldr: madong-admin-saas through 5.1.4 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the platform tenant management API, allowing unauthenticated attackers to manage tenants.
action: Upgrade madong-admin-saas beyond version 5.1.4.

headline: Control Web Panel Auth Bypass Vulnerability
tldr: Control Web Panel (CWP) before version 1.12 contains an execution after redirect vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication.
action: Upgrade Control Web Panel to version 1.12 or later.

headline: WAVLINK WN536AX6-A Web Management Interface Command Injection
tldr: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the web management interface of WAVLINK WN536AX6-A V260507_2.0.0 via the group_name argument. A public exploit is available.
action: Apply available vendor patches or restrict access to the web management interface.

headline: WAVLINK WN536AX6-A WireGuard CLI Command Injection
tldr: An OS command injection vulnerability affects the WireGuard CLI component in WAVLINK WN536AX6-A V260507_2.0.0 via the group_name argument. A public exploit exists.
action: Apply patches provided by WAVLINK and restrict management access.

headline: WAVLINK WN536AX6-A OpenVPN Handler Command Injection
tldr: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the openvpn_cli handler of WAVLINK WN536AX6-A V260507 via the file_id argument. A public exploit is available.
action: Update to patched firmware or disable vulnerable protocol handlers.

headline: WAVLINK WN536AX6-A WireGuard Component Command Injection
tldr: An OS command injection vulnerability impacts the WireGuard component in WAVLINK WN536AX6-A V260507 via group_id or group_name arguments. A public exploit has been disclosed.
action: Apply available vendor updates.

headline: WAVLINK WN536AX6-A OpenVPN Handler Buffer Overflow
tldr: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the OpenVPN handler of WAVLINK WN536AX6-A V260507 via the openvpn_ip argument. A public exploit is available.
action: Upgrade to patched firmware versions.

headline: WAVLINK WN536AX6-A Host Blacklist Command Injection
tldr: An OS command injection vulnerability affects the host_black function in WAVLINK WN536AX6-A V260507 via the mac argument. A public exploit has been released.
action: Apply vendor patches.

headline: Termix-SSH File Manager Path Traversal Vulnerability
tldr: A path traversal vulnerability exists in Termix-SSH Termix up to 2.9.2 via the destPath argument in the file transfer plugin. A public exploit is available.
action: Update Termix to core v26.10.0 or standalone File Manager plugin v1.0.0+.

headline: WAVLINK WN551X3-A WireGuard CLI Command Injection
tldr: An OS command injection vulnerability affects the WireGuard CLI handler in WAVLINK WN551X3-A M51X3_V251020-WO-182e965 via the group_name argument. A public exploit is available.
action: Apply vendor firmware updates.

headline: WAVLINK WN551X3-A DNS Resolution Handler Command Injection
tldr: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the DNS Resolution Handler of WAVLINK WN551X3-A M51X3_V251020-WO-182e965 via the data argument. A public exploit is available.
action: Upgrade to patched firmware.

headline: VOLTA Infostealer Uses LLMs to Rank Stolen Financial Data
tldr: A new Windows infostealer called VOLTA harvests browser credentials, Outlook profiles, and Slack workspaces, utilizing large language models to prioritize stolen data by monetization value.
action: Monitor endpoints for unauthorized use of API calls to LLM services by unknown processes and typical credential-stealer behaviors.

headline: WAVLINK WN553X1-B WireGuard CLI Command Injection
tldr: WAVLINK WN553X1-B V260403_2.0.0 contains a remote OS command injection vulnerability in the WireGuard CLI Group Handler. A public exploit has been disclosed.
action: Restrict access to WAVLINK devices and apply vendor patches when available.

headline: Canonical LXD and MicroCloud Client Impersonation Flaw
tldr: A critical flaw in Canonical LXD and MicroCloud allows attackers with a trusted client's public certificate to impersonate that client over the HTTPS API without a private key.
action: Apply patches for LXD and MicroCloud provided by Canonical.

headline: Northflank Security Breach Exposes API Keys
tldr: Cloud application hosting platform Northflank suffered a security breach resulting in the unauthorized use of customers' AI API keys stored on the platform.
action: Rotate all credentials, API keys, and secrets stored on Northflank.

headline: Jpom Authentication Bypass and RCE Vulnerability
tldr: Jpom 2.10.0 through 2.11.12 contains an authentication bypass flaw via injected query conditions in the JPOM-USER-TOKEN header, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute commands.
action: Upgrade Jpom to patched versions and restrict network access.

headline: AJ-Report Hard-Coded JWT Secret RCE Vulnerability
tldr: AJ-Report through 1.7.1 uses a hard-coded JWT secret to sign share tokens, allowing attackers to forge tokens and achieve unauthenticated remote code execution via GroovyClassLoader.
action: Upgrade AJ-Report beyond 1.7.1 and rotate signing keys.

headline: Android SMS of Death CVE-2026-58882 PoC Released
tldr: A proof-of-concept exploit has been released for CVE-2026-58882, an Android vulnerability enabling remote crashes or cellular service disruption via a crafted text message.
action: Apply the latest Android security patches.

headline: OpenAI ChatGPT Share Link Arbitrary Code Execution Flaw
tldr: A vulnerability in ChatGPT allowed malicious shared links to execute arbitrary code within the logged-in session of users who opened them, exposing private conversations. OpenAI patched the issue.

headline: Chainalysis Data Breach Exposes Customer Identity Data
tldr: Chainalysis confirmed an external actor accessed internal tools and non-sensitive customer identity data, though investigation content and credentials remained uncompromised.
action: Audit access logs and monitor for fraudulent activity related to exposed customer identity data.

headline: imgproxy ICO Loader Integer Overflow RCE Vulnerability
tldr: An integer overflow in the ICO loader of imgproxy, imgproxy/v2, and imgproxy/v3 allows remote code execution or denial of service via a crafted network request.
action: Upgrade imgproxy to the latest patched version.

headline: Signal K Server Path Traversal JWT Secret Disclosure and RCE
tldr: A path traversal flaw in signalk-server and @signalk/resources-provider allows unauthenticated users to read arbitrary files, including the JWT signing secret, leading to RCE.
action: Upgrade signalk-server and @signalk/resources-provider to patched versions.

headline: Linux Kernel MPTCP Remote Root RCE Vulnerability
tldr: Researchers developed an exploit for a critical Linux kernel vulnerability enabling unauthenticated remote root execution on servers with MPTCP listeners.
action: Monitor for Linux kernel updates addressing MPTCP vulnerabilities and apply patches promptly.

headline: China-Linked Vapor Panda Uses AI-Powered ARTEX Against Over 200 Orgs
tldr: Chinese state-sponsored threat group Vapor Panda used an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to target over 200 organizations.
action: Review environment for indicators associated with Vapor Panda and unauthorized penetration testing frameworks.

headline: actions/pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish: CA trust store issue in PyPI publishing
tldr: pypi-publish action versions before 1.14.2 bundled a revoked root CA in the certifi trust store used for Sigstore Trusted Publishing and Digital Attestations.
action: Upgrade actions/pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish to version 1.14.2 or later.

headline: Ivanti Connect Secure Predictable Numbers Flaw Added to KEV
tldr: CISA added CVE-2026-118527, a predictable numbers vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure that allows remote file uploads, to its KEV catalog.
action: Apply vendor mitigations and follow CISA BOD 26-04 guidance immediately.

headline: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Auth Privilege Escalation Flaw Added to KEV
tldr: CISA added CVE-2026-111357, a missing authentication vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure allowing privilege escalation, to its KEV catalog.
action: Apply vendor mitigations and follow CISA BOD 26-04 guidance immediately.

headline: Binance Suffers Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist
tldr: Binance experienced a record-breaking crypto heist resulting in the theft of $6.3 billion, linked to North Korean threat actors.
action: Review platform exposures and asset protections if interacting with affected services.

headline: Trezor Warns of Hardware Implant in Reseller Wallet
tldr: Trezor warned customers about a suspected hardware implant in a Trezor Safe 5 wallet sold by reseller CryptoBilis that leaks recovery phrases over a mobile network.
action: Move funds to a new wallet with a new recovery phrase if purchased from CryptoBilis.

headline: Florida Department of Education Data Breach Exposes SSNs
tldr: The Florida Department of Education reported that 4.9 million people had Social Security numbers leaked in a data breach involving the Florida Student Financial Aid website.
action: Monitor credit reports if affected.

headline: IBM Langflow OSS Deserialization RCE Vulnerability
tldr: IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.3 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability allowing remote code execution via message broker access.
action: Upgrade IBM Langflow OSS to version 1.12.5 or later.

headline: IBM Langflow OSS Stored Python Component Execution Flaw
tldr: IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.4 allows remote attackers to trigger pre-existing stored Python component code in public workflows.
action: Upgrade IBM Langflow OSS to version 1.12.5 or later.

headline: OpenDeepWiki Hard-Coded JWT Signing Key Vulnerability
tldr: OpenDeepWiki through 2.0.6 contains a hard-coded JWT signing key vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens.
action: Upgrade OpenDeepWiki beyond version 2.0.6.

headline: MuseBot Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
tldr: MuseBot before 2.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge admin sessions using a hard-coded session key.
action: Upgrade MuseBot to version 2.0.0 or later.

headline: InternLM LMDeploy Unauthenticated RCE Vulnerability
tldr: InternLM LMDeploy 0.9.0 through 0.18.0 contains an unauthenticated RCE vulnerability allowing attackers to execute OS commands via pickled data sent to the /update_weights endpoint.
action: Upgrade InternLM LMDeploy beyond version 0.18.0.

headline: TeamViewer Host-to-Viewer Attack Vulnerability
tldr: TeamViewer patched a vulnerability that allows a compromised or malicious host machine to attack the remote user connecting to control it during a session.
action: Update TeamViewer to the latest patched version.

headline: NetamLoader Malware Targets Government Windows Systems in Asia
tldr: Attackers are targeting government Windows systems in Asia with NetamLoader, a new malware utilizing legitimate Microsoft software components.
action: Review endpoint telemetry for suspicious use of native Microsoft binaries downloading payloads.

headline: FBI Seizes Domain of Bulletproof Host Virtualine
tldr: The FBI seized the domain of bulletproof hosting provider Virtualine, which supported ransomware, infostealers, and hack-for-hire services.

headline: Attacker Tried to Exploit Alpine Linux’s GitLab via CVSS 10.0 Flaw Its Ruby Left Open
tldr: An attacker tried to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability on the Alpine Linux project's own GitLab server a week after GitLab released a fix, Alpine Linux said on 28 October. The flaw, CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS score: 10.0), can let an attacker run code on a GitLab server through a crafted regular expression in a CI configuration.

Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. headline: Hackers Exploited Cisco SD-WAN Flaw to Plant Malware Built to Steal Encryption Keys
tldr: Hackers exploited a critical Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN flaw, fixed in February, to plant custom malware inside the systems that control an organization's SD-WAN network. The malware, called KeyDrift, is designed to copy the keys that encrypt traffic between sites and store them for later use, Cisco Talos said on October 28.

headline: Hackers Actively Exploit Highly Critical Drupal Commerce Core Authorization Bypass Flaw
tldr: Drupal has warned that threat actors are exploiting a "highly critical" security flaw in its Commerce Core component. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-118539 (CVSS score: N/A), is a case of missing authorization affecting Commerce Core versions from 0.0.0 to 2.41 and from 3.0.0 to 3.3.13.

headline: Fake ChatGPT and Claude Apps Abuse Signed Executables to Deploy Crypto Miners
tldr: Threat actors are delivering malicious loaders and cryptocurrency miners under the guise of artificial intelligence (AI) desktop applications for Anthropic Claude and OpenAI ChatGPT as part of a campaign dubbed Yoba. headline: CVE-2026-103409: A Missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in Juniper Networks Session Smart Router a
tldr: A Missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in Juniper Networks Session Smart Router allows an unauthenticated network-based attacker to obtain administrative privileges by passing crafted URL parameters to an insecure endpoint running as root. Note that this vulnerability can only be exploited prior to the device being onboarded to Mist/Conductor.

headline: Hitachi Energy CoreTec Product
tldr: View CSAF Summary Hitachi Energy is aware of OS command injection and Dirty Frag vulnerabilities that affect CoreTec product versions listed in this document. Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could result in impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the product.

headline: CVE-2026-103406: An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command vulnerability in the AutomatedProv
tldr: An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command vulnerability in the AutomatedProvisioner in Juniper Networks Session Smart Conductor allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

headline: Volt Typhoon Used Covert Silent Train Network in Four Zero-Day Exploitation Campaigns
tldr: The China-nexus cyber espionage group known as Volt Typhoon has been attributed to a now-disrupted covert access network dubbed Silent Train that has been put to use for zero-day exploitation and strategic access. headline: rust:zip: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Lea
tldr: Affected packages: rust:zip. ## Summary A critical architectural parser differential exists in the `zip` crate (`<= 9.0.4`) between random-access archive readers (`ZipArchive`) and streaming readers (`ZipStreamReader`).

headline: Hugging Face malware campaign returns to hijack GPUs for crypto mining
tldr: A crypto-mining campaign abusing Hugging Face models returned days after takedown, hijacking GPU servers and planting backdoors, with one model downloaded over 28,000 times. Separately, a fake Solana starter kit on GitHub is positioned to trick AI coding agents into installing a NetSupport RAT.

headline: Japan Airlines suffers third-party data breach exposing passenger info
tldr: Japan Airlines (JAL) has announced that a data breach at Amadeus's Passenger Service System exposed the data of about 92,000 customers. [...]

headline: Polymarket halts trading after crypto-draining script breach, $2.5M traced
tldr: Prediction market platform Polymarket temporarily suspended trading on Thursday after hackers compromised a third-party service to distribute cryptocurrency-draining JavaScript, with approximately $2.5 million in assets traced to a suspected attacker wallet. [...]

headline: Limited reports of PHP bug exploitation emerge
tldr: One cyber firm listed a half-dozen exploitations of the PHP2Shell bugs, and another identified a well targeted, suspected Chinese campaign that breached U.S. "government affiliated" servers.

headline: Fresh WordPress Vulnerability in Attackers’ Crosshairs
tldr: Threat actors are attempting to exploit a high-severity unauthenticated race condition leading to remote code execution. The post Fresh WordPress Vulnerability in Attackers’ Crosshairs appeared first on SecurityWeek .

headline: $2 Million+ Drained From Polymarket Traders in New Supply Chain Attack
tldr: Malicious code linked to a website monitoring tool was designed to hijack logged-in Polymarket sessions and siphon user funds. The post $2 Million+ Drained From Polymarket Traders in New Supply Chain Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .

headline: Official Claude Code VS Code Extension Compromised to Install Persistent SSH Backdoor
tldr: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed that the official Anthropic Claude Code extension was compromised on the Open VSX registry to install a persistent SSH backdoor on infected hosts. The issue has since been traced to the compromise of the Cursor Marketplace, prompting the AI coding platform Cursor to briefly take down the service to remove the malware.

headline: PHP2Shell Attack Roots 25 Servers, Breaches U.S. Government-Affiliated Network
tldr: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of what appears to be an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted attack orchestrated by a suspected China-nexus threat actor that has leveraged the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to breach exposed systems. The activity, which was observed on October 25, 2026, involved an attacker combining PHP2Shell with a kernel privilege escalation exploit to root

headline: Hackers Target Critical Oracle E-Business Suite RCE Flaw Days After Security Patch
tldr: Threat actors are beginning to probe for a newly patched critical vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), according to threat intelligence firm Defused Cyber. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-101767 (CVSS score: 9.8) , a case of improper authentication in the Oracle Application Object Library of Oracle E-Business Suite.

headline: Siemens Mendix SAML Module
tldr: View CSAF Summary Mendix SAML module contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized access by replaying a valid SAML assertion in IdP-initiated authentication flows. Siemens has released new versions for the affected products and recommends to update to the latest versions.
